meta.title: No Asteroids
meta.demoScope: First 15 days of the contract (save carries over on the same PC)
meta.objective: Excavate 5,000,000 m³ asteroid in 90 days (or play No Rush mode)

handheldTools.name: Pickaxe
handheldTools.notes: Your initial mining tool on Day 1. Best used only to reach early surface veins and fund your first upgrades and ship weapon slot.

handheldTools.name: Sledgehammer
handheldTools.notes: First major upgrade after the Pickaxe, breaking dense surface rock chunks faster per swing.

handheldTools.name: Drill
handheldTools.notes: Ideal for boring straight corridors toward deep mineral veins detected on your HUD mineral scanner.

handheldTools.name: Laser
handheldTools.notes: Allows safer extraction from a distance—helpful when carving around unstable pockets or overhead veins.

handheldTools.name: Plasma Cutter
handheldTools.notes: Features four confirmed upgrade branches: Hit (damage per cut), Tempo (fire/swing speed), Sweep (area coverage), and Luck (bonus yield/finds).

handheldTools.name: Missile Swarm
handheldTools.notes: Top-tier handheld gear with tactical toggle modes: Spread Fire for wide surface clearing and Tunnel Mode for punching deep shafts.

shipWeapons.name: Basic Turrets / Autocannons
shipWeapons.notes: Your mothership begins completely unarmed. Mounting your first roof gun unlocks 'Gun on the roof' and passively removes m³ while you mine inside.

shipWeapons.name: Rockets
shipWeapons.notes: Fires explosive salvos into the asteroid hull to clear outer layers faster than kinetic turrets.

shipWeapons.name: Railgun
shipWeapons.notes: High-impact kinetic cannon suited for cracking denser mid-crust rock formations.

shipWeapons.name: Mass Driver
shipWeapons.notes: Sustained heavy bombardment designed to keep pace with escalating daily quota demands.

shipWeapons.name: Orbital Strike
shipWeapons.notes: High-tier orbital demolition system capable of stripping huge sections of asteroid volume per cycle.

shipWeapons.name: Collapsar (Black Hole Weapon)
shipWeapons.notes: Fires a localized black hole that pulls massive chunks of rock and thousands of loose fragments inward, dramatically accelerating late-game clears.

shipWeapons.name: Remaining 3 Ship Weapon Slots (9 Total)
shipWeapons.role: Full Hull Arsenal ('Armed to the teeth')
shipWeapons.notes: The mothership supports 9 total automated weapon systems/slots. Exact names and credit costs for the remaining 3 slots are being verified from full-release runs.

utilitiesAndDrones.name: HUD Mineral Scanner
utilitiesAndDrones.notes: Color-codes and filters mineral veins through rock. Always scan before swinging so you never burn oxygen on barren tunnels.

utilitiesAndDrones.name: Oxygen & Cargo Capacity Upgrades
utilitiesAndDrones.notes: Prioritize these alongside early tools. Oxygen is your round-trip ticket; cargo capacity reduces wasted flights back to the lander.

utilitiesAndDrones.name: Jetpack
utilitiesAndDrones.notes: Dramatically improves vertical mobility inside deep craters and speeds up emergency returns before lander liftoff.

utilitiesAndDrones.name: Tractor Beam
utilitiesAndDrones.notes: Pulls floating ore fragments and drifting debris toward you or the collection zone without manual chasing.

utilitiesAndDrones.name: Digger / Prospector / Sapper Systems
utilitiesAndDrones.notes: Specialized automation/role systems: Digger (autonomous rock breaking), Prospector (resource gathering/vein assist), and Sapper (explosive charges).

ores.name: Space Ice
ores.notes: Abundant near the outer shell. Reliable starter cash before deeper veins open up.

ores.name: Meteoric Iron
ores.notes: Primary early-game bread-and-butter ore. Watch terminal prices if you dump huge loads consecutively.

ores.name: Nickel
ores.notes: Commonly found alongside Meteoric Iron as you push past the outer crust.

ores.name: Titanium
ores.notes: Higher-density structural ore that fuels mid-game drill, laser, and ship slot purchases.

ores.name: Star Gold
ores.notes: High-value vein target worth filtering on your HUD mineral scanner.

ores.name: Space Crystal
ores.notes: Distinctive crystalline pockets offering strong value-per-cargo-slot returns.

ores.name: Plasmite
ores.notes: Deep-layer high-payout resource needed to finance Plasma Cutter branches and heavy ship turrets.

ores.name: Neutronium
ores.notes: Ultra-dense deep core mineral requiring upgraded laser/plasma or explosive tools.

ores.name: Dark Matter
ores.notes: Exotic late-game material found near the asteroid's center, helping bankroll endgame ship weapons.

ores.name: Antimatter
ores.notes: Volatile core substance. Smashing Antimatter triggers a detonation (unlocks the 'Boom' Steam achievement).

minimum.cpu: 4 cores — Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
minimum.gpu: DirectX 11 GPU with 2 GB VRAM (GTX 1050 / RX 560 / Intel Iris Xe)

recommended.cpu: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
recommended.gpu: GeForce GTX 1660 or Radeon RX 5600 XT (4 GB VRAM)

recommended.cpu: Apple M1 Pro, M2, or newer
